entries.name: Subtitle / Caption Generator
entries.description: Generate subtitles/captions (e.g. SRT) from a video's audio.

usage.outputShape: body.captions[] (each {text, start_time, end_time}), body.accuracy_score, body.visual_descriptions[], body.processedAt
quirks: inputSchema was null in registry; the correct field is video_url (a public URL to a video file).
Output is structured JSON captions with timecodes, not an SRT file; build SRT yourself from body.captions[] if needed.
Response also includes visual_descriptions[] and an accuracy_score.
usage.guide: POST to https://gg402.vercel.app/video_caption_generator with a JSON body {"video_url": "<public video URL>"}, paying $0.010 USDC on Base (x402, no auth/sign-in). It returns 200 synchronously with a JSON object. Read body.captions[] for the timed caption segments (each has text, start_time, end_time in seconds); body.visual_descriptions[] gives scene descriptions and body.accuracy_score gives a confidence value. If you need an SRT file, assemble it from body.captions[] yourself.
